_help: Act 2, McKenna's tavern: recruiting Isabelle Moreau (hired_isabelle). Money alone won't do; you must prove yourself: Hargreaves in the party, act1_gunfight_won (Act 1's armed confrontation won), or settling her bounty-hunter trouble (heard_isabelle_trouble from McKenna's rumours: event fight_bounty_hunters, end_fight). After that fight is won, act2.gd sets isabelle_trouble_settled and starts this talk again for free; it goes straight to her terms. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

after_fight.speaker: isabelle
after_fight.line: Three of them, and not a scratch on you. All right, monsieur. You've earned a hearing.

first.speaker: isabelle
first.line: Don't. Whatever you're about to say, I've heard it, and the answer is no.

choices.label: Offer her work
choices.line: I'm leading an expedition into the desert. I could use you.

who.speaker: isabelle
who.line: Isabelle Moreau. I find people who don't want to be found, and I keep people alive who don't always deserve it. Sometimes both.

test.speaker: isabelle
test.line: Everyone wants a gun. Not everyone deserves one at their back. Why should I follow you anywhere?

choices.label: Hargreaves vouches for me
choices.line: Tom Hargreaves is coming. Ask him about me.

choices.label: You saw Freddie's office
choices.line: You were across the street when those gunmen came for me at Freddie's office. You saw how that ended.

choices.label: Offer to deal with her trouble
choices.line: Those three by the window have been watching you all night. Want me to have a word?

choices.label: Shoot a bottle off the bar
Order her
choices.line: Because I'm the one in charge, and I'm offering good money.

vouched.speaker: isabelle
vouched.line: Hargreaves? He doesn't vouch for his own mother. Fine. Let's talk money.

saw_fight.speaker: isabelle
saw_fight.line: I did. Not bad, for a man with empty pockets. Let's talk money.

trouble.speaker: isabelle
trouble.line: They think I owe someone a shipment that went missing. I don't. But be my guest.

bottle.speaker: isabelle
bottle.line: Very pretty. Bottles don't shoot back.

order.speaker: isabelle
order.line: Then you'll be in charge of it without me.

come_back.speaker: isabelle
come_back.line: Come back when you've done something worth hearing about.

terms.speaker: isabelle
terms.line: Forty-five pounds. I choose my own position in a fight, and nobody tells me to stand down.

choices.label: Agree
choices.line: Forty-five, and your fight is your own.

choices.label: Pay, but she takes orders
choices.line: Forty-five. But out there, you do what I say.

joined.speaker: isabelle
joined.line: Then we understand each other. Try to keep up.

joined_cool.speaker: isabelle
joined_cool.line: We'll see who does what, monsieur.
